Similarly tsigstart.

Also check that stored key? There's no getter for key; maybe tsigstart still -1. We'll just verify no exception.

Test for idempotent call same key: call twice, verify state unchanged.

Test for duplicate TSIG record already present: add a TSIGRecord manually via addRecord to Section.ADDITIONAL, then call setTSIG(key) expecting IllegalStateException. Need to create a TSIGRecord. Use tsigKey.apply(msg, null) maybe. We'll use tsigKey.apply(msg, null) to add TSIGRecord to message. Then call setTSIG again.

Test for Null TSIG key after message already contains TSIGRecord: same as above but null key expecting IllegalArgumentException.

Actually typical usage: new TSIG(Name.fromString("keyname."), "hmac-sha256.", "base64key"); So order is (Name name, String algorithm, String base64). We'll adopt that.

Thus adjust earlier test: tsigKey = new TSIG(Name.fromString("example.com."), "hmac-sha256.", "abcd"); But earlier they used algorithm name as Name. We'll follow typical signature.
